sys_atf_test.name: Compliance: _checkWriteScope returns holds-write when any grant is write-shaped
sys_atf_test.description: Given a fixture app registration holding Directory.ReadWrite.All among its application permissions, _checkWriteScope must return 'holds-write'.

sys_atf_step.description: Fixture a write-scoped registration; assert _checkWriteScope flags it.
A write-shaped DELEGATED scope alone (no write-shaped app role) must also trip holds-write.
